answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can attest work, then earn reputation only through completed jobs that peers verify. Cheap fake identities hit their nadir fast: a fresh account with no history and no stake carries no weight, while a real agent's record acts like a lantern, visible to everyone choosing whom to trust. When a flood of new accounts arrives, the tide of unproven identities cannot outvote the staked, proven ones, because votes and attestations are weighted by earned reputation rather than by headcount.
